_comment: Databricks Workflow definition for Customer CDC Pipeline.
Migrated from: scripts/run_customer_cdc.ksh
Original trigger: AutoSys job JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC (every 4 hours)
Ab Initio -> Databricks Mapping:
run_customer_cdc.ksh             -> This workflow JSON definition
AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC         -> Databricks cron schedule (every 4 hours)
4 sequential air sandbox runs    -> 3 notebook tasks (audit absorbed by Delta CDF)
customer_cdc.pset parameters     -> job_parameters with matching defaults
-partition 8                     -> partition_count parameter (8)
RUN_TS=$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S) -> {{job.start_time}} dynamic reference
name: customer_cdc_pipeline
description: Customer CDC pipeline — snapshot, detect changes, apply to target. Runs every 4 hours. Migrated from Ab Initio KornShell orchestration (run_customer_cdc.ksh).

schedule._comment: Every 4 hours starting at midnight UTC. PAUSED for initial deployment.

job_parameters.name: source_path
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET SOURCE_PATH=/data/raw/customer in customer_cdc.pset

job_parameters.name: hash_columns
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET HASH_COLUMNS=customer_id,name,address,phone,email,status (adjusted for customer.dml schema)

job_parameters.name: partition_count
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET PARTITION_COUNT=8 / -partition 8 in run_customer_cdc.ksh

job_parameters.name: enable_deletes
job_parameters._comment: Enable soft-delete for customers removed from source

_comment: Step 1: Snapshot current state from source.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/snapshot_customer.mp
Reads source customer data into bronze layer.
tasks.description: Step 1: Snapshot current customer state from source systems

_comment: Steps 2+3: Compare with previous snapshot and apply changes.
Ab Initio equivalent: cdc_detect_customer.mp + apply_customer_changes.mp
Merged into a single Delta Lake MERGE operation.
In Ab Initio these were two separate graph executions;
Delta MERGE handles detection and application atomically.
tasks.description: Steps 2+3: Detect CDC changes and apply via Delta Lake MERGE

_comment: Step 4: Generate audit trail.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/audit_customer_changes.mp
In Databricks, Delta Change Data Feed (CDF) provides the audit trail
automatically. This task validates the CDF output and logs statistics.
tasks.description: Step 4: Validate audit trail via Delta Change Data Feed

query.query_string: SELECT _change_type, COUNT(*) as change_count, current_timestamp() as audit_timestamp FROM table_changes('{{job.parameters.target_table}}', (SELECT MAX(version) FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY {{job.parameters.target_table}}))) GROUP BY _change_type ORDER BY _change_type

job_clusters._comment: Cluster sized for CDC workload with 8 partitions (matching Ab Initio partition count).

email_notifications._comment: Replaces Slack webhook alerts from Ab Initio JobMonitor._send_alert()

on_failure._comment: Configure Slack/PagerDuty webhook for failure alerts

rules._comment: Alert if pipeline takes >60 minutes (SLA breach detection)
